questions.question:

When I asked for an expensive dress for my friend’s wedding, my mother reminded me that money does not grow on trees.
options: Money is freely available to spend

questions.solution: D) money does not grow on trees" (idiom) – Money is hard earned and limited पैसा कठिनाई से कमाया जाता है और सीमित है।
